verdict.rationale: Ollama states that prompts are never tracked or trained on, and that locally run models never send data off the machine. Users are protected from training use by default, without needing an opt-out. The support is marketing-level first-party claims only, with no detailed policy documentation or independent verification, especially for the cloud offering. Missing for 10: a detailed privacy or data-retention policy for Ollama Cloud, independent or hands-on corroboration of the no-training claim.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models

citations.quote: Your prompts are never tracked or trained on.
Nothing you run locally ever leaves your machine.
Ollama lets you use open models with your coding agents so you can spend less while keeping your data private.
